description: Use before buying a pump.fun token when you have its Solana mint address. Returns advisory flags evaluated on selected historical tokens; no flags does not mean safe. Optional idempotency_key is random 32-byte base64url. Without it, the first signed call returns an unpaid job_id; echo that job_id with the same proof and mint when ready. get_job_result reports processing and retry_after_s for free; the result appears there only after settlement. Costs $0.01 USDC via x402.

idempotency_key.description: Optional canonical base64url encoding of 32 random bytes. Reuse with the original payment proof and identical inputs to recover a lost reply.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

job_id.description: Accepted job ID to echo with the original payment proof and identical inputs when recovering a call made without idempotency_key.
job_id.title: Job Id

mint.description: Base58 Solana token mint address to check before buying; not a transaction or token symbol.
mint.title: Mint

prefer_async.description: If work is queued or running, return a job status instead of waiting for completion. Poll get_job_result for free, then retry this tool with the same payment proof and inputs when ready; payment does not settle while processing.
prefer_async.title: Prefer Async

name: check_solana_token_risk
